independent_computation.step_0_what_the_leaf_is: The leaf is not a damage number; it is a receipt-shape node hanging off the rotation object of the index-0 fight of a coupled roster scenario. Two things are independently checkable from the evidence tree: (a) the cardinality seven, and (b) whether an EMPTY dependency ledger is the correct content for the index-0 fight of a Cleaver+Bloodsong roster.

step_1_scenario_ingredients_from_cached_.why_this_matters: Both effects are TARGET-SIDE debuffs: Carve is armor reduction on the target (per docs/math-foundations.md:459 the engine applies percent reduction only while R>0, never below 0), and Expose Weakness is explicitly 'increased damage from all sources'. Both therefore have the shape of a coupling: whoever applies them changes the damage every other roster member deals. That is exactly the class of state a dependency ledger would record.

step_2_cardinality_seven.note: E Umbral Dash and R World Ender author no damage row (E is a dash + heal passive; R grants bonus AD 20/30/40% and healing, damageType None). So seven is the exact number of damage-bearing rotation rows Aatrox can author, and a per-row dependency container of cardinality seven is structurally consistent with this scenario. This enumeration is corroborative, not decisive - the schema itself is not visible in the evidence tree.

step_3_should_the_ledgers_be_empty.governing_design_statement: data/atoms/autoresearch-review.md:95 - "The `_later_target_amount` receipt design is correct: each pair fight cannot see the roster, so the engine authors the full value with an explicit reduced receipt; the coupled ledger re-prices defenders past the first (`defender_index > 0`)."
step_3_should_the_ledgers_be_empty.consequence_a: The rotation of a pair fight is computed by a walk that BY CONSTRUCTION cannot see the roster. Whatever the rotation consumes is intra-fight state. External (roster) coupling is applied afterwards by the coupled ledger, not inside the rotation. So a dependency ledger hung off `rotation` is expected to be empty in the ordinary case.
step_3_should_the_ledgers_be_empty.consequence_b: Re-pricing is applied only to `defender_index > 0`. Index 0 is the head of the coupling order and receives no re-pricing. This leaf is the index-0 fight ('fights/0:Aatrox'), i.e. precisely the position the documented model says consumes nothing from the coupled ledger.
step_3_should_the_ledgers_be_empty.consequence_c: The Cleaver/Bloodsong effects present in this roster are produced INSIDE this fight's own timeline (Carve stacks are applied by the attacker's own physical damage; Spellblade/Expose Weakness is armed by the attacker's own ability cast then spent on the next auto). A self-produced debuff is already priced into the seven damage rows themselves (armor reduction on the mitigation term, amp on the damage term). It is not a dependency on another fight, so it does not belong in the ledgers.
step_3_should_the_ledgers_be_empty.conclusion: For fight index 0 of a coupled roster, seven empty dependency ledgers is the correct value. The key's appearance is a receipt-shape addition; its emptiness is the documented behaviour of the head-of-order fight in the pair-fight/coupled-ledger model. No numeric leaf in this fight changed alongside it, which is consistent with a purely explanatory receipt rather than a new computation input.

step_4_why_not_the_alternatives.old_value_correct_rejected: Nothing in the sources says a rotation receipt must not carry a dependency ledger. Absence of the key is strictly less information than an explicit empty ledger, and the golden gate's purpose is to pin emitted structure; an explicit empty ledger is the stronger, falsifiable pin.
step_4_why_not_the_alternatives.both_wrong_rejected: 'both_wrong' would require naming a specific dependency entry the sources demand for THIS fight. I could not derive one: every Cleaver/Bloodsong effect reachable in fight 0 is produced by fight 0 itself, and the documented coupling model gives index 0 no inbound re-pricing. Asserting non-empty content here would be a guess, not a computation.

confidence_and_falsifiers.what_is_solid: The coupling model quoted from data/atoms/autoresearch-review.md:95 puts index-0 fights outside the re-pricing path, and every Cleaver/Bloodsong effect reachable in this fight is self-produced, so nothing in the cached sources demands a non-empty entry for fight 0.
confidence_and_falsifiers.what_is_not_verifiable_from_data: The receipt schema for `rotation.dependencies` is defined in src/, which this runbook forbids reading, so the exact key set behind 'seven' could not be confirmed - only that seven is exactly Aatrox's damage-bearing rotation-row count.
confidence_and_falsifiers.falsifier: If fights at index > 0 in this same coupled scenario ALSO show seven empty ledgers, the resolver is inert and this verdict should flip to both_wrong: the documented model says defenders past the first are re-priced, so at least one later fight must carry a non-empty dependency ledger. Checking a sibling leaf (e.g. fights/1:*/rotation/dependencies) settles it.
